mapper.sql: SELECT c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.annual_fee, c.card_issue_url, cc.company_id, cc.company_name, b.benefit_id, b.benefit_title, b.benefit_summary, b.benefit_description, b.benefit_icon_url, bgd.benefit_grade_id, bgd.type, bgd.amount, bgd.limit_count, bgd.limit_amount, bgd.min_payment, g.grade_id, g.start, g.total_discount, cat.category_id, cat.category_name, cat.category_image_url FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_company cc ON c.company_id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON c.card_id = b.card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_grade_discount bgd ON b.benefit_id = bgd.benefit_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.card_id = g.card_id AND bgd.grade_id = g.grade_id LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.benefit_id = bc.benefit_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON bc.category_id = cat.category_id
mapper.select: select company_id from card_company where company_name=#{cardCompanyName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card (card_name, card_type, card_image_url, card_issue_url, company_id) VALUES (#{card.cardName},#{card.cardType},#{card.cardImageUrl},#{card.cardIssueUrl},#{cardCompanyId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_card SET is_deleted = true, deleted_at = NOW(), last_modified_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{cardId} AND is_deleted = false
UPDATE user_card SET is_deleted = false, deleted_at = NULL, last_modified_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{cardId} AND is_deleted = true
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND card_id = #{cardId} AND is_deleted = false )
